why_this_file_exists: VITALA_3_drug_source_manifest.json was referenced in the brief but was not found among the provided files. These set IDs were looked up by the implementing engineer via the openFDA drug label API on 2026-11-10. Notebook 02 uses VITALA_3_drug_source_manifest.json automatically if you place it in data/raw/medications/; until then it uses this candidate file and marks every medication record manifest_status=CANDIDATE_NOT_USER_VERIFIED.
selection_rules: Prefer the reference brand (NDA) label when it is present in openFDA
If the brand label is not in openFDA, use an immediate-release tablet label from the original manufacturer (not a repackager)
